about_the_game:
Autonomous Vehicles

The technology race is on. Your competition is adopting AI-based tools and automation. If you don’t want to be left behind, you need to upgrade your fleet with the latest technological innovations. Invest in autonomous cars, drones, and robots to finish orders without the driver's assistance.

Research Tree

Now you can make your company truly distinct from others! Research up to 16 new talents that will help you with your day-to-day business. Upgrade them to increase the bonuses. Invest in Research Tree and observe as your company blooms!

New Campaign - Sydney

Mr. Husk and Mr. Li are in the middle of an autonomous war in Australia. The one to win the technological race will dominate the whole market. Choose your side wisely and help them beat the competition in this 5-day-long, engaging campaign.

Key Features

  • New Campaign Scenario - Sydney, Australia
  • 8 new autonomous Vehicles - including drones and robots
  • New Feature - Research Tree with 16 distinct Upgrades
  • New Feature - Active Abilities
  • New Feature - Parking Spot
  • New Feature - Corruption
  • 8 new Achievements
  • 1 new Game Restriction
  • 1 new Vehicle Upgrade
